notes:
Seti Astro Suite Pro

V1.19.18
Major overhaul of all rejection algorithms in Stacking Suite to be much more robust to outlier data (ie satellite trails and hot pixels), refactored how remove satellite trail is done during light calibration, remove satellite trail will clip to black the satellite trails in the calibrated images themselves removing the need for the _sat_mask.py files. Complete redo of how CFA drizzle is handled to have true rejection layer utilized and a refactor of how cfa per channel statistics and noise characteristics are derived.

New debayer method added: VNG. This will be selectable not only from the Debayer utility but directly in Stacking Suite Image Integration tab for your choice of debayer method: VNG, EDGE, Bilinear, Straight CFA.
